Mormugao Port Authority Officer Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Mormugao Port Authority Officer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Mormugao Port Authority Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 03 September 2026. Candidates should report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Officer (Environmental) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Officer (Environmental) position in the Mormugao Port Authority Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for the Officer (Environmental) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MSc. in Environmental Science from Goa University to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Officer (Environmental) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Officer (Environmental) post is 30 years as of 01 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Officer (Environmental) role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Verification followed by an Oral Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Contractual.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Officer (Environmental) post?
faq.answer: Candidates will receive attractive remuneration with a 3% increment after one year.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The specific venue details will be available in the official notification. Candidates are advised to check the official PDF for the exact location.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant certificates as mentioned in the notification.
